camel_example: aliyun polardb DescribeActiveOperationTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskType all --Region all
description_en: Queries the details of pending tasks
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-active-operation-task --biz-region all --task-type all --api-version 2017-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTask

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query the regions and zones supported by PolarDB.

You can enter all to view all pending tasks under your account.
When `Region` is set to all, `TaskType` must also be set to all
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看PolarDB支持的地域和可用区。

您可以输入all查看您账户下所有的待处理认任务。
当`Region`设置为all时，`TaskType`也必须设置为all
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The task type. You can call the [DescribeActiveOperationTaskType](ID not yet generated) operation to query the task types of pending tasks.

You can also enter all to view all pending tasks under your account.
When `TaskType` is set to all, `Region` must also be set to all
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，您可以调用[DescribeActiveOperationTaskType](还未生成ID)接口查看待处理任务的任务类型。

您也可以输入all查看您账户下所有的待处理认任务。
当`TaskType`设置为all时，`Region`也必须设置为all
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return historical tasks. Valid values:
0: Returns current tasks.
1: Returns historical tasks.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回历史任务，取值范围如下：
0：返回当前任务
1：返回历史任务

默认取值为0
parameters.name: is_history

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值为30、50或100。

默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format (UTC)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建任务的时间点，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）

Deadline.description_en: The latest deadline for adjusting the task execution time. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format (UTC)
Deadline.description_zh: 任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期限，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）

ModifiedTime.description_en: The modification time. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format (UTC)

PrepareInterval.description_en: The preparation time before the transient disconnection. The time is in the `HH:mm:ss` format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 闪断时间前的准备时间，格式为`HH:mm:ss`

Region.description_en: The region where the task is located

StartTime.description_en: The time when the task is executed in the background. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format (UTC)
StartTime.description_zh: 后台执行该任务的时间点，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The task status.
If you set `IsHistory` to 0, the details of the pending task status are returned. Valid values:

    * 2: waiting for the user to set the task start time
    * 3: waiting to be processed
    * 4: being processed

If you set `IsHistory` to 1, the details of the historical task status are returned. Valid values:
     * 5: task completed and executed successfully
     * 6: task completed but execution failed
     * 7: task canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。
若您设置`IsHistory`为0，则返回待处理任务状态的详情，取值范围如下：

    * 2：等待用户设置任务开始时间
    * 3：等待处理
    * 4：任务正在处理中

若您设置`IsHistory`为1，则返回历史任务状态的详情，取值范围如下：
     * 5：任务结束且执行成功
     * 6：任务结束但执行失败
     * 7：任务已取消

SwitchTime.description_en: The time of the transient disconnection. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format (UTC)
SwitchTime.description_zh: 闪断时间点，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
